# OAuth1 Client fails to handle SIGNATURE_TYPE_QUERY properly

### Feature or Bugfix

- Bugfix

### Purpose

The OAuth1 Client class is not properly handling the SIGNATURE_TYPE_QUERY signature type. When this signature type is specified, the code path for preparing the request URI with query parameters is missing, causing the client to fail.

### Detail

When using the OAuth1 Client with SIGNATURE_TYPE_QUERY, the prepare_request method doesn't properly handle this signature type, resulting in an error.

How to reproduce:

```python
from oauthlib.oauth1 import Client
from oauthlib.oauth1.rfc5849 import SIGNATURE_TYPE_QUERY

# Create a client with query signature type
client = Client(
    'client_key',
    client_secret='client_secret',
    signature_type=SIGNATURE_TYPE_QUERY
)

# This will fail
uri, headers, body = client.prepare_request('https://example.com/resource')

# The error occurs because the code path for SIGNATURE_TYPE_QUERY is missing
```

The client fails to prepare the request properly when SIGNATURE_TYPE_QUERY is specified, which should add the OAuth parameters to the query string of the URI instead of using an Authorization header.
</issue>
